description: Source file implementing Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) payload handling and PDU serialization/deserialization for the Thunder project.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Handles SDP payload descriptor pushing and reading.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Manages SDP Protocol Data Units including serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: Payload::PushDescriptor
methods.description: Pushes a descriptor of a given type and size into the SDP payload buffer.

methods.name: Payload::ReadDescriptor
methods.description: Reads a descriptor's type and size from the SDP payload buffer.

methods.name: PDU::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: PDU::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a PDU object.
